items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: But Van wrote every note out that he wanted. So you just played it.

ctx.x: Of the Stylistics’ stuff, when the Stylistics started doing stuff. And this was after they were out of Philly or wherever they were from originally. Then they started doing stuff in New York. And Van was so specific with his charts, you just read the charts, no vocal. You never heard the vocal until the record came out. And it was all – so once again you never knew which situation you were going to walk into. But Van wrote every note out that he wanted. So you just played it. Even though it was rhythm & blues it…
Until you’re in the car and you hear the radio.
